changes.input: App uses typed prepare/offer/edit results and a local refusal for host conversion. An admitted pending completion gets its own status and remains retryable. Existing explicit cancellation policy for rejected unfinished input stays in the App.
changes.model: PreviewEditResult drives refusal and revision publication. Existing export retry reads the immediate typed failure.
changes.export: Hide lastError only from Objective-C/Swift. Kotlin JVM getLastError remains present. The original Android consumer compiles.
changes.persistence: Original checkpoint, ledger, IO and identity paths retained; the host regression suite exercises existing pending recovery and canonical reopen.

scope: Original iOS App host XCTest on iOS simulator, real Kotlin/Native compiler headers, iPhoneOS Swift source typecheck and Kotlin JVM/Android build. The isolated test result does not include GUI, real Pencil, native device runtime, physical heap or release timing. Native device framework has a retained file manifest and is not duplicated in the test archive.
